name: Landscape

unlock.how: finish the first step of a project: bashou project

tips: `bashou project` : a real program to build, one small step at a time.
Stuck on a step? `bashou project hint` gives you a nudge, never the answer.
A step done is a stone laid. Say so with `bashou project next`, and I grow a little.
Small first, then better: every program you use today started as a few lines that barely worked.
personal: Every town started as a hill with one tree on it.
Rome wasn't built in a day. Your photo sorter won't be either, and that's fine.
I grow with every step you finish. No hurry: rivers take their time too.
